resources.string: No other devices yet. Approve a new device to let it act for your identity.
The node doesn\'t list this phone any more. It may have been removed from another device.
Your devices are kept by your home node. Join a node to add devices.
Tap to unlock with your screen lock.
This is Boson Identity on this phone, with its own key. It can\'t be removed from this list; to give it a new key, use Security.
This device can administer the node.
This device can reset a forgotten passphrase.
%1$s will no longer be able to act for your identity. To use it again, you\'ll have to approve it again.
Your account has a passphrase. Removing a device needs it.
%1$s will be removed from your identity at %2$s
Your identity\'s key isn\'t backed up yet. Until you\'ve saved it and checked the copy, it can\'t approve or remove devices.
On the new device, choose to join with a device you already have. Scan the code it shows, or paste its text.
This isn\'t a pairing code. Scan the code the new device shows, or paste its text.
If that isn\'t where the new device is, deny the request.
This request expired. Ask the new device for a new code.
It asks for your identity key
This device will receive your identity key and can act fully as you, everywhere. Approve only a device you own and trust.
This device joins with its own key; it never receives your identity key.
It can then manage the node, its users and its plans. Leave this off unless you need it.
Your account has a passphrase. Approving a device needs it.
It now appears in your devices. You can rename or remove it there.
Scan the code a web page shows to sign in with Boson Identity, the code a new device shows to join your identity, or the code a node\'s console shows to make you its administrator. Or paste its text.
Boson Identity can\'t use this code. Scan the code a web page, a new device or a node\'s console shows, or paste its text.
The device was not added to your identity.
This request expired or was already answered.
Ask the new device to show a new code.
The node didn\'t allow this. Only an administrator can let a device administer the node.
A web page wants to sign in as you
Only approve a sign-in you started yourself, just now, on this node. If someone sent you this code, refuse it.
Pick the number the page shows
Back up your key before you sign in anywhere with it.
This sign-in expired. Start again on the page.
The page is signed in as you. It can\'t add devices: those join through this app.
The page was not signed in.
That wasn\'t the page\'s number, so the sign-in was refused. If you started it, start again on the page.
It expired, or was already answered. Start again on the page.
Only an administrator of this node can sign in to its admin dashboard.
%1$s at %2$s will be signed in as you
Join a node first: this code is answered at your home node.
On approval, %1$s becomes this identity\'s home node, this phone one of its devices, and the identity the node\'s administrator.
On approval, this identity becomes an administrator of its home node, %1$s, with this phone one of its devices.
Only continue if you started this yourself, just now, on the node\'s console. The console then asks for the number this phone shows.
Back up your key before you use it to administer a node.
Type this number on the node\'s console
Keep this screen open until the console approves.
The Dashboard, on the Identity tab, opens the node\'s administration.
The console denied the request, or a wrong number was typed. To try again, start again on the console.
Another phone claimed this code before this one. If it wasn\'t yours, deny the request on the console, and start again.
It expired, or was already used. Start again on the node\'s console.
This identity lives on another node
An identity has one home node, and this one\'s is %1$s. To administer %2$s, use an identity that has no home node yet, or lives there.
This identity\'s account on the node is deactivated.
